svg.title: First use: install, a three-step wizard (You, Summary, Link), download of the recent history, creation of the 9:00 and 18:00 schedules and the first summary.

g.text: Your name and the account name
Pick the AI and test the connection
Scan the QR code with your phone
and pick it up where you left off
Before choosing the AI you see:
what it costs, whether your chats
leave your computer, to whom they
go and what it does with them.
If the QR expires, it renews itself
